Event from 1 April to 1 May (free hunting)

Every year, from 1 April to 1 May, an ice bridge links Svargrond to the frozen island of {wiki:Chyllfroest}. The island is full of cold creatures and even the odd {creature:Yeti}, and it is the **only** way to tame the {wiki:Ursagrodon} mount.
Only available between 1 April and 1 May.
Equipment and potions for hunting ice creatures.
Only while the ice bridge to {wiki:Chyllfroest} is open (1 April to 1 May).
It is the only way to tame an Ursagrodon: look for the skeleton trapped in the ice, inside the island's mountain.
This is a special Mini World Change: it is not random, it **always** happens from 1 April to 1 May, every year.
Make the most of the month: it is the only time of year you can tame the Ursagrodon.
1. Find out whether the event is active

The messages announcing this Mini World Change are: *"An ice bridge now connects Svargrond to a frosty island, where monsters and a strange frozen creature have been sighted."* or *"An icy bridge reaches toward an isle of frost and hidden fire, with cold-hearted monsters grim and dire."*

Leave **Svargrond** and go to the cave of the {creature:Frost Troll|Frost Trolls} that is on the way to the shortcut to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}. Instead of going down to the shortcut, head **west**, towards the Quara scouts' cave. The ice "bridge" to {wiki:Chyllfroest} starts at {coord:32068,31093,7}.
In **Svargrond**, cross the ice bridge that connects the city to the island of {wiki:Chyllfroest}.

The island has a great variety of creatures: {creature:Badger|Badgers}, {creature:Winter Wolf|Winter Wolves}, {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears}, {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} and, sometimes, a {creature:Yeti}.
Explore the island and look for the "strange frozen creature" the messages talk about: this is where you have your only chance to tame an {wiki:Ursagrodon}.

The Ursagrodon is not a creature: it is a skeleton stuck in an ice wall inside the Chyllfroest mountain. There are several on several floors, but the easiest to reach are on the **1st underground floor, on the east side** of the mountain. You can go around the mountain via the **southeast**, so you do not need to pass the {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} to get there.
The Ursagrodon frozen in the ice

To leave, go back the same way: climb back up to the surface, cross the ice bridge at {coord:32068,31093,7} and return to **Svargrond**. If you go deeper into the dungeon in the east, on the **5th underground floor** there is a **Geyser**: step on it to be taken back to the surface, at the foot of the mountain.
The surface Geyser, where you arrive when you leave via the underground Geyser
